result.instructions: Tools for Peecho, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which print products can I order in hardcover, and what does a 200-page book cost to ship to Germany?"; "Create a print order for 50 copies of this PDF and ship it to my warehouse."; "What is the status of order 50786?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Peecho data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run peecho_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run peecho_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run peecho_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. peecho_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: peecho_list_categories
tools.title: List product categories
tools.description: List Peecho product categories and their sub-category codes (for example Books / HC). Use a sub-category code with peecho_list_offerings. Peecho API: GET /rest/v3/categories.

tools.name: peecho_list_offerings
tools.title: List offerings
tools.description: List the print products (offerings) available to this merchant, grouped by category code. Each offering has an id, name, paper type and minimum quantity. Peecho API: GET /rest/v3/offering/list.

subCategoryFilter.description: Sub-category code from peecho_list_categories, e.g. HC (hardcover books).

tools.name: peecho_get_offering_countries
tools.title: Get shipping countries for offerings
tools.description: Return the countries each offering can ship to. Read-only. Peecho API: POST /rest/v3/offering/countries.

items.description: Offering id (the id field from peecho_list_offerings).

tools.name: peecho_get_offering_spine
tools.title: Get spine width for an offering
tools.description: Calculate the spine width (in millimetres) an offering needs for a page count in a country. Read-only. Peecho API: GET /rest/v3/offering/spine.

offering_id.description: Offering id (the id field from peecho_list_offerings).

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. NL.

number_of_pages.description: Number of pages in the print file.

annotations.title: Get spine width for an offering

tools.name: peecho_request_quote
tools.title: Request a price quote
tools.description: Return prices, currency and shipping for items sent to a destination. It does not create an order. Peecho API: POST /rest/v3/quote.

offering_id.description: Offering id (the id field from peecho_list_offerings).

state.description: Destination state or region code, where needed.

tools.name: peecho_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get an order's state (for example OPEN or PAID), price data, shipping address and items. Read-only. Peecho API: GET /rest/v3/order/details.

order_id.description: The order id (from peecho_create_order or the Peecho dashboard).

tools.name: peecho_get_order_spine
tools.title: Get spine widths for an order
tools.description: Return the spine width for each item in an order. Read-only. Peecho API: GET /rest/v3/order/spine/.

order_id.description: The order id (from peecho_create_order or the Peecho dashboard).

annotations.title: Get spine widths for an order

tools.name: peecho_create_order
tools.title: Create a print order
tools.description: WRITE: create an OPEN print order with one or more items. It does not pay for the order, and nothing is printed until it is paid in Peecho. Items need a unique item_reference. Peecho API: POST /rest/v3/order/.

item_reference.description: Your own reference for this item. It must be unique across Peecho orders.

offering_id.description: Offering id (the id field from peecho_list_offerings).

file_details.description: The print file. Omit it and send the file later with peecho_set_order_files.

content_url.description: Public URL of the print file (PDF).

content_width.description: Print width in millimetres (the Peecho example uses 210).

content_height.description: Print height in millimetres (the Peecho example uses 210).

address_details.description: Customer and shipping address. Set it later with peecho_update_order_address if omitted.

state.description: State or region code, where the country uses one.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. NL.

tools.name: peecho_update_order_address
tools.title: Update an order's address
tools.description: WRITE: replace the customer email and shipping address on an open order. Peecho API: POST /rest/v3/order/address.

order_id.description: The order id (from peecho_create_order or the Peecho dashboard).

state.description: State or region code, where the country uses one.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. NL.

tools.name: peecho_set_order_files
tools.title: Set an order's print files
tools.description: WRITE: send the print file URL for each item of an order. Each merchant_item_reference must match an item_reference of the order. Peecho API: POST /rest/v3/order/files.

merchant_item_reference.description: The item_reference of the order item.

source_file.description: Public URL of the print file (PDF).
